notes.message: Transparent areas were filled with white.
Only the first frame of the animation was kept.
Only the first page was kept.
Each animation frame became a separate page.
Formatting such as fonts, colours and images is removed.
Only the text is kept; layout and pictures are not.
Only the sound is kept.
Sound is removed, and colours are limited to 256.
Only the first 30 seconds were turned into a GIF.
AAC is compressed, so some audio detail is lost.
Subtitle positions and styling are removed.
LRC lyrics only keep when each line starts; end times are dropped.
MicroDVD times are counted in video frames; check the frame rate matches your video (23.976 fps unless the file says otherwise).
Headings, lists, links, tables, bold and italic are kept; fonts, colours and images are not.
The image was made square and saved at every standard icon size.
The RAW photo was developed with the camera's default settings.
Entries with unsafe paths (absolute, or containing ..) were left out.
Links pointing outside the archive and special files were left out.
The text was converted to UTF-8.
The text was turned into a QR code.
Only the QR codes and barcodes in the image are read.
Only names, organisation, emails, phones, addresses, birthday and note are kept.
Tracks and routes become one row per point.
Times are kept only for tracks where every point has one.
Nested values became columns named like "a.b"; lists were written as JSON text in one cell.
The first row became the keys; numbers and true/false became typed values, empty cells null.
Attributes became "@name" keys and text "#text"; values stay text, comments are dropped.
Keys that aren't valid XML names were adjusted.
Dates and binary data were written as text (ISO 8601 dates, Base64 data).
Property lists can't store empty (null) values, so those were left out.
Cells longer than Excel's limit of 32,767 characters were shortened.
Page layout and the book's own styling are not kept; the text reflows.
Some pictures couldn't be found in the file and were left out.
Files in the comic that aren't pictures were left out.
Each page became a JPEG picture, so its text can no longer be selected.
Materials and textures may not carry over.
Separate texture and material files (.mtl, images) can't be included.
Only the largest table was kept; convert to JSON or SQL to get every table.
Binary values (blobs) were written as Base64 text.
It held a TAR archive, so the result is that archive. Add “.tar” to its name if needed, then drop it on Ameya to unpack or convert it.
Transcribed on this Mac; check names and technical terms.
Links to outside images, fonts or style sheets were left out.
Location information was removed.
Camera details, location and other hidden information were removed.
The picture was made smaller.
It couldn't be made quite that small; this is the smallest version Ameya could make.
The background was replaced with a plain one. Check the edges around your hair.
No outline of a person was found, so the original background was kept.
The photo didn't reach every edge, so plain background was added. A photo with more space around you works better.
Your face is small in this photo, so it was enlarged and may look soft. A closer or sharper photo works better.
Your head was tilted, so the photo was turned to level your eyes.
Your face seems turned away. Most countries need you to look straight at the camera.
Your eyes may be closed. Most countries need your eyes open.
Rules differ between offices and change over time: check the official requirements before you submit.
The video was trimmed to the chosen start and end.
The sound was removed.
The video was re-encoded to make it smaller, so some detail is lost.
It was already small enough, so it was kept as it was.
Pages that are mostly pictures were saved as smaller JPEG pictures; text pages are unchanged.
Text was recognised on the scanned pages; check names and numbers.
Text was recognised from scanned pages; check names and numbers.
The text was recognised on this Mac; check names and numbers.
Keep the password somewhere safe: Ameya can't recover a forgotten one.
